newsitem.title: USA: SSE Telecom says may recover retrofit costs.
newsitem.headline: SSE Telecom says may recover retrofit costs.

text.p: SSE Telecom Inc said on Thursday that it may recover costs related to a retrofit program, for which it had set aside a warranty reserve of $1.8 million.
In a statement, SSE, a manufacturer of satellite earth station parts, said the warranty reserve reflected costs incurred for retrofitting certain of the company's satellite transceiver products.

The company said that it was in discussions with the vendor that identified a defect in many transcievers produced by SSE and that it believed it may be entitled to recover costs related to the retrofit program.
"We have begun identifying and retrofitting transceivers affected by this problem, and we expect to complete the retrofit program during the next six months," the company said.
